featured_snippets.question_header: What is the official NFL Week 9 schedule and which teams are on bye?
featured_snippets.direct_answer: The 2026 NFL Week 9 schedule features 15 official games across 30 active teams, with the Pittsburgh Steelers (PIT) and Tennessee Titans (TEN) on bye. Key Sunday matchups include DET at MIA, GB at NE, DAL at IND, NYG at PHI, LV at SF, and ARI at SEA, followed by BUF at MIN on Monday Night Football.

steps: Verify active Week 9 roster status, QB1 starters, and Friday DNP/Out injury designations.
